fusions.name: Latch On
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 3s. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Unshaken Throw
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 28 damage, harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at maximum range. Every hit is a critical hit. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 3s.

fusions.name: Shared Grip
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Never Lets Go
fusions.desc: Each weapon strike makes you heal for 15% of all damage you deal for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
